mapper.sql: tenant_id AS tenantId,reward_id AS rewardId,participant_id AS participantId,relation_id AS relationId,mode,threshold_count AS threshold, policy_hash AS policyHash,CAST(rule_json AS CHAR) AS ruleJson,entitlement_state AS entitlementState,authorization_state AS authorizationState, delivery_state AS deliveryState,compensation_state AS compensationState,row_version AS revision,qualification_revision AS qualificationRevision,progress_revision AS progressRevision

choose.when: SELECT invitee_key AS subjectKey,subject_key_version AS keyVersion,invitee_cipher AS cipher,encryption_key_id AS encryptionKeyId FROM mk_referral_relation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND participant_id=#{participant} AND relation_id=#{relation}
choose.otherwise: SELECT subject_key AS subjectKey,subject_key_version AS keyVersion,subject_cipher AS cipher,encryption_key_id AS encryptionKeyId FROM mk_referral_participant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND participant_id=#{participant}

mapper.select: SELECT FROM mk_referral_reward WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM mk_referral_reward WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND participant_id=#{participant} AND entitlement_state='ELIGIBLE' AND (relation_id=#{relation} OR (mode='MILESTONE' AND threshold_count>#{validCount})) ORDER BY rule_id,reward_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_referral_reward SET qualification_revision=#{q.revision},progress_revision=#{progress.revision},row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} AND row_version=#{previous} AND entitlement_state='ELIGIBLE'

UPDATE mk_referral_reward SET entitlement_state='INVALIDATED', compensation_state=CASE WHEN compensation_state IN ('CANCELLED','REVERSED','MANUAL_REVIEW') THEN compensation_state WHEN authorization_state='NONE' AND delivery_state='NOT_SUBMITTED' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, authorization_state=CASE WHEN authorization_state='NONE' THEN 'NONE' ELSE 'CANCEL_REQUESTED' END, cancel_revision=#{revision},row_version=#{revision},qualification_revision=#{q.revision},progress_revision=#{progress.revision},updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} AND row_version=#{previous} AND entitlement_state='ELIGIBLE'
